summary: PSB Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing completion of a subscription offering in connection with the mutual-to-stock conversion of Pioneer Federal Savings and Loan Association, after member approval of the Plan of Conversion. The number of shares will be based on final appraisal and regulatory approvals, with no additional offerings. Closing and trading expected in mid-May, subject to customary conditions. Keefe, Bruyette Woods served as marketing agent and financial advisor. This is a mutual conversion process, not a special situation under the listed categories.
